{{Short description|Uzbek-American physicist}}
'''Anvar Abdulakhadovich Zakhidov''' ({{langx|ru|Анвар Абдулахадович Захидов}}, {{langx|uz|Anvar Abdulahadovich Zohidov}}; born 2 May 1953) is an Uzbek-American physicist from the [[University of Texas at Dallas]].<ref>{{cite web |title= Дискуссионный Научный Клуб Наука НИТУ "МИСиС" :: Захидов Анвар Абдулахадович |url=http://science.misis.ru/ru/scientists/international/detail.php?ID=13607 |website=MISiS.ru |accessdate=20 January 2020 |language=ru}}</ref>

==Career==

Born on 2 May 1953 in Tashkent, he worked on superconductors in [[Japan]] for five years before immigrating to the United States in 1997, where he joined [[Honeywell]] in the private sector.<ref>{{cite news |title=Профессор Анвар Захидов: Только когда ты сам владеешь искусством создания материалов, ты можешь их эффективно изучать |url=https://news.itmo.ru/ru/science/photonics/news/6995/ |accessdate=20 January 2020 |work=news.itmo.ru |date=5 October 2017 |language=ru}}</ref> He was installed for his pioneering contributions to the design, fabrication, characterization, and understanding of advanced functional [[nanomaterial]]s and associated devices, including [[carbon nanotube]]s; [[superconducting]] and magnetic [[fullerene]]s; [[photonic crystal]]s; [[solar cell]]s; [[OLED]]s; and [[Cold field electron emission|cold field emission]] [[cathode]]s.

==Awards and recognition==
He was awarded the status of [[Fellow]] in the [[American Physical Society]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=&year=&unit_id=&institution=|title=APS Fellow Archive|website=www.aps.org|language=en|access-date=2017-04-20}}</ref> after he was nominated by the Division of [[materials physics|Materials Physics]] in 2009.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=&year=2009&unit_id=&institution=|title=APS Fellows 2009|website=www.aps.org|language=en|access-date=2017-04-20}}</ref>
